# RealtimeJobs customer API

> Search jobs matching a subscription's saved filters. Customer HTTP documentation and examples, hosted as files on GitHub.

Resolve these relative links against this file's directory. Read files from the same revision. Use GitHub's Raw view for plain text. This index is a navigation aid; give its URL to your agent explicitly.

## Start

- [Agent guide](agents.md): Setup, read order, request workflow, and interpretation rules.
- [Quickstart](README.md): Token setup and a self-contained cURL request.
- [OpenAPI](openapi.yaml): Customer request, response, and error schemas. Production base URL: https://rtj.app.

## Reference

- [Authentication](authentication.md): Issue, list, rotate, and revoke tokens.
- [Search](search.md): Dates, saved filters, ordering, and pagination.
- [Response](response.md): Job and employer fields, nulls, and inferred information.
- [Errors](errors.md): HTTP statuses, error shapes, and bounded retries.
- [Usage and compatibility](usage-and-compatibility.md): Published policy limits and recommended client budgets.
- [Recurring imports](recurring-imports.md): Checkpoints, overlap, identity, and synchronization limits.
- [Changelog](CHANGELOG.md): Documentation corrections and customer-visible contract changes.

## Examples

- [Runnable examples](examples/README.md): Node.js single-page and bounded export scripts.
- [Response with enrichment](examples/response.json): Complete fictional serialized response.
- [Response without enrichment](examples/response-no-enrichment.json): Missing normalized data.
